# Singapore Property & Finance - Daily Brief (property + finance)
_Auto-generated 29 Aug 2026 (SGT). Source-linked. General information only; exact figures and eligibility are confirmed case by case._

## Public Housing Policy Update

- **BTO income ceiling raised to S$16,000; EC ceiling raised to S$18,000** - Prime Minister Lawrence Wong announced at the National Day Rally on 23 August that the BTO monthly household income ceiling has been raised to S$16,000 and the EC ceiling to S$18,000. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/ndr-2026-bto-income-ceiling-raised-to-s16000-ec-ceiling-to-s18000/)

## HDB Resale Records

- **Bedok 5-room flat sells for $1.45M, breaking a record set at the same block three months ago** - A five-room flat at 153B Bedok South Road changed hands for $1,450,000 ($1,192 psf) in August 2026, setting a new Bedok resale record and surpassing the previous high from the same block. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/bedok-5-room-hdb-sold-record-1-45m-same-block-broke-record-3-months-ago/)

- **Bishan's first 4-room flat to hit S$1.3M also sets a new town-wide psf record** - A 4-room HDB resale flat in Bishan sold for S$1.3 million in August 2026, the first 4-room sale in the town to reach that price, at approximately S$1,271 psf. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/bishan-4-room-hdb-records-first-1-3m-natura-loft/)

- **Pasir Ris records its first million-dollar 5-room flat at S$1.15M** - A 5-room DBSS flat at Block 530D Pasir Ris Drive 1 sold for S$1.15 million, the first time a 5-room flat in Pasir Ris has crossed the million-dollar mark. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/pasir-ris-first-million-dollar-5-room-hdb-sale/)

## Private Market Snapshot

- **Condo resale activity picked up in July 2026 even as prices edged lower** - More condo resale units changed hands in July 2026 compared to the prior month, though overall prices dipped slightly and volume remained just below last year's level and the typical monthly figure. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/condo-resale-activity-rebounds-in-july-2026-as-prices-edge-lower/)

- **Singapore prime home prices grew 0.4% in H1 2026, with a stronger H2 forecast** - Prime rents rose 1.7% in the first half of 2026, ahead of the 1.1% global average, and Savills forecasts prime capital values to grow 2% to 3.9% in H2 2026, placing Singapore among the strongest outlooks across 30 cities tracked. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/singapore-prime-home-prices-grew-0-4-first-half-2026-2-signs-point-stronger-second-half/)
